description: Returns the ready-to-send reply for one scenario: what to ask the user first, the reply in Chinese and in English, and an internal note for the agent. Scenarios 01, 04, 11, 12, 22 are FREE. Others return a preview plus payment instructions until you pass pay_tx: one plain transfer of >= $5.00 USDC/USDT (Base, Arbitrum, OP, Polygon, BSC, Ethereum or Solana; not x402) unlocks all scenarios, and scenario="all" returns the whole kit.

pay_chain.description: Chain of pay_tx. Default base (a base58 signature means solana).

pay_tx.description: Only for paid scenarios: hash of ONE transfer of >= $5.00 USDC/USDT to the store address (see payment_options). EVM: 0x + 64 hex; Solana: signature.

scenario.description: Scenario id "01".."25", or "all" for the whole kit, or a few words describing the problem (the best match is used)

name: get_support_reply
title: Get a bilingual support reply (free 01/04/11/12/22; others $5.00 once)
